name: billing-03
description: Recent invoices with their status and amount, what is outstanding and a PDF download for each one.

files.content:
'use client' import { type InvoiceStatus, InvoiceStatusLabel, formatBillingDate, } from '@/registry/components/dashboardblocks/billing' import { BlockReady, BlockStateProvider, type BlockStatus, getBlockState, } from '@/registry/components/dashboardblocks/block-state' import { Details } from '@/registry/components/dashboardblocks/details' import { DataTable, DataTableBody, DataTableCell, DataTableHead, DataTableHeader, DataTableRow, DataTableStateRows, } from '@/registry/components/dashboardblocks/table' import { IconPlaceholder } from '@/registry/icons/icon-placeholder' import { formatCurrency } from '@/registry/lib/dashboardblocks/format' import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button' interface Invoice { amount: number date: Date description: string /** A muted line under the description, such as the period it covers. */ detail?: string id: string number: string status: InvoiceStatus } interface Billing3Props { /** @default 'USD' */ currency?: string /** Leave out, or pass none, to show the empty state. */ invoices?: Invoice[] /** Leave out to hide Download. */ onDownload?: (id: string) => void onViewAll?: () => void status?: BlockStatus title: string } const invoiceDate = (month: number, day: number) => new Date(Date.UTC(2026, month, day)) const exampleProps: Billing3Props = { invoices: [ { amount: 612, date: invoiceDate(8, 14), description: 'Growth', detail: 'Sep 14 – Oct 14', id: 'in_0926', number: 'INV-2026-0926', status: 'due', }, { amount: 180, date: invoiceDate(8, 2), description: 'Extra seats', detail: 'Prorated for 4 seats', id: 'in_0914', number: 'INV-2026-0914', status: 'failed', }, { amount: 588, date: invoiceDate(7, 14), description: 'Growth', detail: 'Aug 14 – Sep 14', id: 'in_0871', number: 'INV-2026-0871', status: 'overdue', }, { amount: 604.5, date: invoiceDate(6, 14), description: 'Growth', detail: 'Jul 14 – Aug 14', id: 'in_0813', number: 'INV-2026-0813', status: 'paid', }, { amount: 541.2, date: invoiceDate(5, 14), description: 'Growth', detail: 'Jun 14 – Jul 14', id: 'in_0760', number: 'INV-2026-0760', status: 'paid', }, ], onDownload: () => {}, title: 'Invoices', } const Billing3 = (props: Billing3Props) => { const { currency = 'USD', invoices = [], onDownload, onViewAll, status, title } = props const state = getBlockState(status, invoices) const unpaid = invoices.filter((invoice) => invoice.status !== 'paid') const outstanding = unpaid.reduce((sum, invoice) => sum + invoice.amount, 0) const money = (value: number) => formatCurrency(value, { currency, maximumFractionDigits: 2, minimumFractionDigits: 2, }) const oldest = unpaid.reduce( (first, invoice) => (!first || invoice.date < first.date ? invoice : first), undefined, ) const description = unpaid.length === 0 || !oldest ? 'Every invoice is paid.' : `${money(outstanding)} outstanding across ${unpaid.length} ${unpaid.length === 1 ? 'invoice' : 'invoices'}, the oldest from ${formatBillingDate(oldest.date)}.` return (

{title}

{description}
{onViewAll && ( )}
Invoice Date Amount Status {onDownload && ( Download )} {!state && invoices.map((invoice) => ( {invoice.description}
{invoice.number} {invoice.detail}
{formatBillingDate(invoice.date)} {money(invoice.amount)} {onDownload && ( )} ))}
) } export { Billing3, exampleProps as billing3ExampleProps, type Billing3Props }
